_instructions: 2. L2 board (18076098477) groups are already configured.
3. To add L1 board: find the L1 board ID from Monday.com, set 'l1_board_id',
then run: python upload_to_monday.py discover --board L1_BOARD_ID
and fill in 'l1_group_map' with the printed group IDs.

group_map._comment: L2 board — Discovered from board 18076098477 (L2 - Checklist Version x Scoring).

column_map._comment: Only the item name column is writable on L2 (all others are mirrors/formulas).

l1_group_map._comment: L1 board groups. Run: python upload_to_monday.py discover --board L1_BOARD_ID

l3_column_map._comment: L3 board writable columns. 'Name' → 'name' sets the Monday item title.
l3_column_map.Name: name

l3_column_aliases._comment: Alternative pipeline column names for each Monday column ID (Q&FS uses different names).

l3_sync._comment: Set sync_label to the exact label text of the 'Synch Version and criteria' status column that triggers the Monday automation. Run 'python upload_to_monday.py discover --board 10065306343' and check color_mkwbaxzj settings_str for available labels.
